item.title: Trump claims U.S. is achieving 'very big victory' in Iran conflict
item.description: As the Iran war nears six months, Trump says there is no specific timeline for peace talks.

item.title: Actor Tim Curry passes away at 80
item.description: The British actor, known for roles in 'The Rocky Horror Picture Show' and 'Home Alone 2,' has died.

item.title: Federal judge removes all blocks on Trump's mail-in ballot order
item.description: The ruling clears legal obstacles to implementing the president's executive order.

item.title: 24 states sue to halt new Postal Service mail voting rules
item.description: The states and D.C. argue the new rules violate the Constitution and federal law.
